title: Remediation target
description: Where fixes land: the deployment's private mirror organisation, the self-hosted forge hosts whose repositories are their own downstream fork (fixes land in place there), and the naming of index repositories and fix branches. No shipped default: the mirror organisation is the adopter's. A Tier 2 setting: a scope-ref document imported whole with no assessment and versioned by traust-core's settings service (`traust settings`), so a change is a successor version with its `revision`, never an edit; readers take the latest.

revision.description: Who set this version and why. Written by traust-core's settings service from the verified caller (or the recording run) and its clock; a caller never supplies it.

set_by.description: The principal (<kind>:<identity>) or run that set this version.

reason.description: Why it changed, in the setter's words.

naming_prefix.description: Prefix of per-product index repositories, the control repository and commit subjects; traust when absent.

fix_branch_prefix.description: First segment of fix branch names; fix when absent.

private_forge_hosts.description: Bare hostnames; a host matches itself and any subdomain.
